---
title: "embedpdf paths with a percent sign"
resources:
  - "files/100%.pdf"
  - "files/50%off.pdf"
  - "files/sample copy.pdf"
---

This is a normal page, not a self-contained one, so the browser loads each PDF
from its path. `files/100%.pdf`, `files/50%off.pdf`, and
`files/sample copy.pdf` are copies of `sample.pdf`. The shortcode writes a `%`
that is not followed by two hex digits as `%25`, so a bare `%` reaches the
server as a valid address. The checks in `tests/` read the embed names and
check that each page is drawn. A PDF render of this page shows each PDF once.
